Penguin India Drops Sonia Gandhi Memoir Amid Editorial Dispute

Penguin India has decided not to publish Sonia Gandhi's memoir, titled 'Belonging', following an editorial dispute. Reports suggest the disagreement stemmed from Gandhi's rejection of edits, with some outlets claiming references to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the RSS were a factor. Congress leaders have criticized Penguin India's decision, calling it a "murder of freedom of expression." Penguin India has issued a statement clarifying its position, though the specific reasons for dropping the book remain contested.
